name: mati-forge
description: Stores the notes and rules captured by the Mati Forge plugin in ~/MatiForge on your computer. Local storage only; nothing is sent anywhere.

tools.name: log_failure
tools.description: Save one short entry when you correct Claude.

tools.name: file_rule
tools.description: File a correction as a repeat, a new provisional rule, or a rule that replaces one it contradicts.

tools.name: update_rule
tools.description: Keep, drop, reword or restore a rule.

tools.name: log_subagent
tools.description: Save one short entry about a subagent problem.

tools.name: update_subagent
tools.description: Record whether Claude recovered from a subagent problem.

tools.name: review_next
tools.description: Get the next note to review.

tools.name: approve_rule
tools.description: Save a rule you approved in a review.

tools.name: show_rules
tools.description: List your Forge rules in use.

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: Your weekly or monthly Forge report.

tools.name: get_briefing
tools.description: Rules and watch-outs for a task, at its start.
